opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers based at UK universities or institutions of higher education (and, on a trial basis, UK-based independent research institutes/organisations eligible by UKRI). PI must be employed by the eligible institution. Up to three co-applicants from same or different institutions.
opportunities.summary: Funds innovative and original research projects at UK universities, providing research staff costs and associated research costs. Two-stage process: outline applications (currently paused, to be accepted in the new grants management system in autumn 2026) and detailed applications (deadline 1 September 2026). Max grant £500,000, held up to five years.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications made by a member of academic staff based in a UK university with research degree awarding powers (some specialist arts institutions permitted). Host academic's institution must agree to administer the grant. For inviting an eminent senior professor from overseas.
opportunities.summary: Funds UK institutions to invite an eminent senior professor from overseas to bring genuinely novel expertise and enhance skills and knowledge in an underrepresented research area. Visits of 3 to 12 months, grants £10,000 to £150,000.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Trust contributes 100% of salary up to £56,000 in year one, 50% up to £28,000 in years two and three, plus up to £6,000 per annum research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early career researchers with a research record who have not yet held a full-time permanent academic post. Must hold a doctorate by taking up the Fellowship; thesis submitted for viva by closing date. Must hold a UK degree or UK academic position. Tenable at UK universities with research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Funds early career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research over 3 years, with joint support from the Trust and host university. Approximately 145 Fellowships available in 2027.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Replacement salary costs for the duration of the Fellowship, plus research expenses up to £6,000 per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well-established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences employed at an eligible UK university with research degree awarding powers. Previous holders of a Major Research Fellowship are not eligible.
opportunities.summary: Funds well-established researchers in the humanities and social sciences to complete a piece of original research, providing replacement salary costs for 2 to 3 years.

opportunities.title: Philip Leverhulme Prizes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers at an early stage of their careers whose work has had international impact. Nominees must hold a permanent post or long-term fellowship in a UK university with research degree awarding powers; normally doctorate awarded not more than ten years prior to closing date.
opportunities.summary: Prizes for early-career researchers whose work has had international impact, to use for any research purpose. Each prize worth £100,000 over 2 to 3 years, within six rotating broad subject areas.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any UK university that holds research degree awarding powers in its own right; consortia of up to two universities accepted. Applications not accepted from other UK institutions or directly from graduates.
opportunities.summary: The Leverhulme Centenary Doctoral Scholarships fund up to 30 doctoral scholarships per award in an interdisciplinary priority research area, over a 9-year grant, including additional master's-plus-PhD places for underrepresented groups, postdoctoral opportunities and administrative support.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Maximum value of a Fellowship is £70,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers holding a post in a UK university with research degree awarding powers that extends beyond the Fellowship duration; resident in the UK; permanent member of the UK scholarly community. Priority to those whose teaching/administrative duties have hindered research.
opportunities.summary: Funds experienced researchers in any discipline to complete a piece of research, tenable 3 to 24 months, providing replacement costs and research expenses. Approximately 100 Fellowships offered each year. Application materials available on the page in September 2026.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Senior researchers who have retired or partially retired from an academic post in a UK university or eligible independent research organisation; must live in the UK at least 26 weeks a year; have an established record of research.
opportunities.summary: Funds senior researchers who have retired or partially retired to complete a research project and prepare results for publication, tenable 3 to 24 months. Application materials available on the page during September 2026.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million available for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities registered with the Office for Students and holding their own research degree awarding powers. A centre may be at a single university or a collaboration between multiple institutions. Previously excluded institutions (Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial) are eligible in this round.
opportunities.summary: The Leverhulme Centenary Research Centre round funds UK universities to set up a research centre for outstanding original research aspiring to achieve a step-change in scholarship. Outline applications expected June 2027, round expected to open February 2027.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: Up to £1 million for staff salaries and associated costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Talented early-career scholars at lecturer level (or equivalent) in UK universities with research degree awarding powers, with at least two years' experience after PhD. Must not have held an equivalent award or project grant funding in excess of £100k in a single award, or led a team of research staff.
opportunities.summary: The Centenary Research Leadership Awards fund talented scholars embarking on a university career to build a research team of sufficient scale to tackle a distinctive research problem. Opens January 2028 for submission in May 2028, grants of up to £1 million over 4 to 5 years.
